goal: Implement a small server-owned feature with a client interface and a focused regression test, following the existing project architecture.

tasks.title: Implement the server-owned feature contract
tasks.objective: Add the server-side state transition and validate every client-provided argument using the existing project conventions.

acceptance_criteria.description: The server owns the authoritative state and rejects invalid client input.

tasks.title: Connect the client interface
tasks.objective: Add a responsive client interaction that calls the approved server contract and handles success and failure states.

acceptance_criteria.description: The client uses the documented contract without trusting client-owned state.
A human verifies the primary interaction and failure state in Roblox Studio.

tasks.title: Add focused regression coverage
tasks.objective: Add or update regression tests for the new contract and its invalid-input cases.
